snippet.title: GRIM : Unreal Engine 5 Capstone Game
snippet.description: Grim is a horror game made in Unreal Engine 5 inspired from Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”. The player will play in a room-oriented 3rd-person perspective as a “ghost” and will observe the world from fixed camera perspectives to solve puzzles and survive the monster’s pursuit.
